general_page.description: Shows the specified page in general menu.

reload_database.description: Reloads the data related to the database.

economy_help.description: Shows the specified page in economy menu.

economy_deposit.description: Deposits the amount into your account, or the target player's when specified.

economy_withdraw.description: Withdraws the amount from your account, or the target player's when specified.

economy_set.description: Sets your account balance, or the target player's when specified.

economy_reset.description: Resets your account balance, or the target player's when specified.

balance_others.description: Shows the specified player account balance.

bank.description: Shows current bank stats or help page.

bank_help.description: Shows the specified page in bank menu.

bank_create.description: Creates a bank with the specified name.

bank_deposit.description: Deposits the amount into your bank. The [player] form credits another player's bank and needs gangland.command.bank.admin.

bank_withdraw.description: Withdraws the amount from your bank. The [player] form debits another player's bank and needs gangland.command.bank.admin.

bank_resetcap.description: Admin: resets the daily deposit / withdraw caps for one player, or every bank account when <all> is given.

spawn_set.description: Sets the spawn location of the specified name.

warp_set.description: Sets the warp location of the specified name.

kit_create.description: Creates a kit using current inventory.

kit_remove.description: Deletes the kit with the specified name.

dealer_create.description: Creates a dealer in the current location.

dealer_remove.description: Removes the specified dealer by id.

gang.description: Shows current gang stats or help page.

gang_help.description: Shows the specified page in gang menu.

gang_create.description: Creates a gang with the specified name.

gang_display_name.description: Sets the display name of the gang.

gang_display_remove.description: Removes the display name of the gang.

gang_economy_deposit.description: Deposits the amount value to the gang.

gang_economy_withdraw.description: Withdraws the amount value from the gang.

gang_members.description: Lists every gang member and their current rank.

gang_kick_player.description: Kicks the player from the gang.

gang_rank_promote.description: Promotes the player to the next rank.

gang_rank_demote.description: Demotes the player to the previous rank.

gang_transfer.description: Transfers gang ownership to another member.

safe_wand.description: Gives the player a safe wand.

wanted_help.description: Shows the specified page in wanted menu.

wanted_clear_others.description: Clears the wanted level of the specified player.

resource_pack.description: Downloads the resource pack to the user.

rank_help.description: Shows the specified page in ranks menu.

rank_create.description: Creates a new rank with the specified name.

rank_add_permission.description: Adds the permission to the specified rank.

rank_remove_permission.description: Removes the permission from the specified rank.

rank_info.description: Gives all the information about the specified rank.

rank_parent_add.description: Adds the rank to the specified parent.

rank_parent_remove.description: Removes the rank from the specified parent.

rank_vaultgroup_set.description: Links the rank to an external Vault permission group so members gain that group on assignment.

rank_vaultgroup_clear.description: Removes the Vault group link from the rank.

bounty.description: Shows the current bounty or help menu.

bounty_help.description: Shows the specified page in bounty menu.

bounty_set.description: Sets a bounty on the player head.

level_help.description: Shows the specified page in level menu.

level_add_experience.description: Adds experience to your level, or the target player's when specified.

level_remove_experience.description: Removes experience from your level, or the target player's when specified.

level_add_levels.description: Adds levels to your account, or the target player's when specified.

level_remove_levels.description: Removes levels from your account, or the target player's when specified.

level_next.description: Shows statistics about the next level.

waypoint_help.description: Shows the specified page in waypoint menu.

waypoint_list.description: Shows a list of registered waypoints.

waypoint_create.description: Creates a new waypoint according to the current location.

waypoint_select.description: Selects the waypoint to easily configure.

waypoint_info.description: Shows a detailed information about the selected waypoint.

waypoint_type.description: Sets the specified waypoint with the specific type.

waypoint_gangId.description: Sets the gangId in that waypoint.

waypoint_timer.description: Sets the timer in that waypoint.

waypoint_shield.description: Sets the shield duration in that waypoint.

waypoint_cost.description: Sets the cost to teleport to that waypoint.

waypoint_radius.description: Sets the radius of affect for that waypoint.

update.description: Checks for a new update for the plugin.

update_download.description: If there was an update it would try to download it.

lootchest_help.description: Shows the specified page in loot chest menu.

lootchest_edit.description: Edit wand settings while holding it.

lootchest_remove.description: Removes the loot chest you are looking at.

fuel_help.description: Shows the specified page in fuel menu.

fuel_add.description: Adds fuel to the item in hand.

fuel_info.description: Shows fuel info for the item in hand.

fuel_refuel.description: Refuels the item in hand to max capacity.

fuel_remove.description: Removes fuel from the item in hand.

fuel_defuel.description: Drains all current fuel from the item in hand without changing max capacity.

fuel_defuel_amount.description: Drains the specified amount of fuel from the item in hand without changing max capacity.

item_help.description: Shows the specified page in item menu.

item_unique_info.description: Shows information about the specified unique item.

item_money_info.description: Shows information about the specified money item or the one in hand.

shop_help.description: Shows the specified page in shop menu.

shop_create.description: Creates a new shop YAML keyed by <key> (filename becomes the shop key).

shop_edit.description: Opens the admin view for a shop; drag items in, L-click to set price, R-click to remove.

shop_list.description: Lists every defined shop key with its buy/sell entry counts.

shop_remove.description: Deletes the shop and its YAML file from disk.

shop_title.description: Opens an anvil GUI to edit the shop's inventory display name; supports &-color codes and spaces.

permissions.description: Shows an overview of every permission category registered by the plugin.

permissions_search.description: Lists permissions matching <query> (category prefix or substring), paginated.

permissions_categories.description: Lists every distinct permission category prefix with its node count.

permissions_check.description: Checks whether a permission is registered with the plugin and Bukkit.

filter_sort.description: Advances the sort cycle of a bound list view (gangs, gang_members, …).

filter_clear.description: Clears every active filter and resets the sort to the binding default.

filter_search.description: Text-filters the bound list view by its NAME field.

filter_set.description: Text-filters the bound list view by an arbitrary field (e.g. DESCRIPTION).

filter_next.description: Cycles an enum-valued field through the comma-separated option list, clearing after the last.
